# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old by the end of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c29 P0](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c38 P63](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0063)</sub>
- **Rank:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c38 P35](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0035)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Brierley Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c38 P35](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0035)</sub>
- **Titles:** Schoolma'am  <sub>[v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c26 P0](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nell with an E  <sub>[v1 c3 P23](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0023)</sub>; Carrots  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>; Lady Lucinda Fitzgerald  <sub>[v1 c8 P54](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0054)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell is a pale, slender, and skinny girl with a sharp chin, a prominent brow, and freckles across her nose. She has large gray eyes that can appear green in different light or tempers, and long, thick red hair that she wears in braids. She later crops her hair very short after a failed attempt to dye it black turns it green.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P37](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0037), [v1 c15 P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036)_

## Personality

Vibrant, imaginative, and intensely romantic, Nell possesses a passionate spirit that makes her prone to dramatic outbursts and quick temper, particularly when mocked about her appearance. She is deeply appreciative of beauty in nature and poetry, constantly inventing creative names for places and things. Though loquacious and easily carried away by daydreams, she is obedient, soft-hearted, and eager to prove herself dutiful and appreciative to those who care for her.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P26](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0026), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)_

## History

Nell is mistakenly brought from a Nova Scotia orphanage to Brierley, Prince Edward Island by Mrs. Alexander Tranter, because Thirza and Obed Abernethy had intended to adopt an eleven-year-old boy to help on their farm. Upon her arrival at Grey Shutters, Thirza initially insists she must be sent back, but Obed is charmed by her loquacious nature, and Thirza eventually agrees to keep her after taking pity on her hard upbringing. Nell adapts eagerly to her new home, forming a deep friendship with her neighbor Isolde Pembroke and naming various landmarks around Brierley. After an outburst of rage against neighbor Agatha Sowerby over comments about her appearance, Nell eventually apologizes and earns Agatha's fondness. Nell attends Sunday school and Brierley school, where she forms a fierce academic rivalry with student Hugh Carrow, who angers her by teasing her about her red hair. Nell mistakenly dyes her hair green with peddler's dye, forcing Thirza to crop it short. When a mix-up over a missing brooch leads Thirza to ban Nell from a Sunday-school picnic, Nell fabricates a dramatic confession, but the brooch is found and she attends after all. During a winter night, Nell successfully saves the life of Isolde's infant sister Posy Fay when she contracts croup, using skills learned caring for twins in her past, which heals a rift with Mrs. Pembroke. After a teacher's punishment prompts Nell to temporarily quit school, she is allowed to study at home, eventually advancing to the fifth class. ## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia to high school teachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned at three months old when both parents died of fever  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, assisting with her children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Adopted by Mrs. Rudge and lived in a clearing up river for over two years caring for her eight children, including three sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Placed in the Marden asylum in Nova Scotia for four months before being brought to Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
